subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in, prediction and skimming: what is a ‘shopaholic’?
outcomes: Predict what an article is about from its title and photo
Skim an article to find the meaning of 'shopaholic'

tf.s: A shopaholic is someone who is addicted to shopping.
tf.why: Yes, a shopaholic cannot stop shopping.

tf.s: A compulsive buyer can easily control how much they spend.
tf.why: A compulsive buyer cannot control their spending.

tf.s: The title and photograph can help you predict what an article is about.
tf.why: They give clues before you read.
That is her job in the article.

tf.s: Katy is a corporate lawyer, too.
Skimming means reading quickly to get the main idea.
tf.why: You skimmed the article in two minutes.

tf.s: 'Corporate' means belonging to a big company.
tf.why: A corporate lawyer works for a big company.

tf.s: In the lesson, women were said to enjoy only the result of shopping.
tf.why: Women were said to enjoy the whole experience; men enjoy the result.

tf.s: You must read every word before you can say what an article is about.
tf.why: Skimming quickly gives you the gist.

tf.s: Over-shopping can be a problem when people cannot control their spending.
tf.why: That is why the women in the article have a problem.

boxes.why: Vanessa works for a big company as a lawyer.
